---
title: "Session 12 guided lab: diagnose and repair"
---

Work in **BIOS6301-mywork.Rproj**. Copy either the [Quarto starter](starter/debugging-lab.qmd)
or [R Markdown starter](starter/debugging-lab.Rmd) into `work/session12/` in your personal repository.
Choose one format. All inputs are synthetic and included. The starter renders as supplied;
complete its TODOs and render again. Submit the source and matching HTML.

## 1. Recognize the symptom

Run the supplied examples. Identify the warning, the captured error, and the silent wrong answer. For `x`, calculate the expected mean by hand and explain the bug.

## 2. Repair one function

Complete the calculation in the supplied `safe_mean()` function; keep its checks unchanged. Compare the result for `x` with your hand calculation, then check `c(2, 4, 6)`. Show that the original function fails the missing-value example and the repair passes.

## 3. Compare calculated numbers

Run the two comparisons below. Explain why they differ and why `isTRUE(all.equal(...))` is useful when checking calculated numeric results.

## Optional: inspect in the Console

Use `debugonce(broken_mean)` to inspect the input and denominator. Keep the debugger commands in an `eval=FALSE` chunk; run them manually in the Console.

## Finish

Restart R and render the saved report. Keep the code, requested results, and short explanations visible.
